Suddenly a portal appeared behind the young girl, and a white-haired little girl around 10 years old walked out of the portal, as she said shaking her head. "Look at the mess you've caused, little girl."
"Can you help him, Aunt?" The young girl asked frantically.
"Fortunately, he just died for a moment, and his soul is still intact." The little girl said she crouched down beside Zhang Fei, then touched his chest and muttered quietly. "Time Reversal!"

Instantly Zhang Fei's body was enveloped by a white light, and soon his body was back to normal, even his wounds had disappeared. The little girl let go of her hand, then stood up and said. "He's all right now, and he'll be awake in no time, little girl. But we have to get back now, otherwise, your father will be mad at you."

"Wait a minute, Aunt." The young girl then crouched down, and she took out two objects, one like a medicine capsule, and the other an injection filled with metallic black liquid, then she said. "En, I'll give them to him, Aunt." The young girl then opened Zhang Fei's mouth and put the medicine capsule-like object into his mouth, then she also injected the metallic black liquid into his body.

The little girl shook her head, then she waved her hand, and a portal opened again. They then walked into the portal, but the young girl turned to Zhang Fei for a moment, as she inwardly muttered. 'I hope you are a good man and make good use of my gift, little boy.'

The energy in the spirit beast's meat will greatly help them, their physique can become stronger, they are also less susceptible to disease, and it can also prolong their lifespan.] Mei explained.
Zhang Fei fell silent after hearing Mei's explanation, and he thought of a way to bring the spirit beast meat to earth, since he still doesn't have a storage ring.
Mai giggled, knowing his mind.
[Actually, you don't need a storage ring, Master.
Since you can store everything in the inventory system, you can try calling it 'Inventory', and you don't have to worry, because they can't see it.]
'Inventory!' Zhang Fei tried it straight away, and the next second a large translucent box appeared in front of him, he was dumbfounded at that. 'Isn't this like storage in a game?
Anyway, how much is this inventory capacity, Mei?'
[Hmm, the inventory can hold a thousand items, and each item is around 500kg]
'Sigh, I don't know how the creator could have created a system like this, but this helped me a lot.' Zhang Fei muttered with satisfaction in his heart.
After they finished breakfast, Zhang Fei went with Chu Ying and Chu Qing to cultivate in the formation in the back garden, and an hour later two successive notifications appeared in his mind.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 200 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 200 Red Jewels Sent To Inventory]
[Congratulations!
Your cultivation broke through to 6 Star Elementary Realm]

On the roof, some distance from the back garden, Liu Qingyu's eyes continued to gaze lovingly at Zhang Fei, and she muttered in shock as he broke through again. 'That little fox is too extraordinary, his cultivation has increased so easily, he has even reached 6 Star Elementary Realm in a short time.'
Feeling the shockwaves from Zhang Fei's body, Chu Ying and Chu Qing opened their eyes, and they stared at him dumbfoundedly.
Chu Qing soon lifted Zhang Fei up and kissed his fox lips for a moment before saying in admiration.
"You are truly extraordinary, Qiao!
Last night, you were still at the 1 Star Elementary Realm, but you have now reached the 6 Star Elementary Realm.'
Unlike her little sister, Chu Ying kept looking at Zhang Fei in doubt, apart from his terrifying cultivation speed, she was also curious about her dream last night. 'Is he that man?
But how can he turn into a human if he is still a newborn beast?'
Chu Qing suddenly said.
"Hey, Big Sis.
How about we take Qiao on a trip to town?
Or maybe we can take him on a beast hunt; the Python-Tailed Tiger's meat is so delicious, he will like it a lot."
Mei laughed at Chu Qing's words.
[Haha, she really thinks of you as a pet, Master.]
'Sigh.' Zhang Fei couldn't help but sigh inwardly.
"En.
We can go take him to beast hunting, but we have to tell Mom first." Chu Ying replied by nodding in agreement.
After that, they brought Zhang Fei to meet Liu Qingyu, and she agreed to the wishes of her two daughters.
They then prepared everything beforehand, and they immediately left their clan residence once everything was ready.

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Swamp Forest
paragraphs: In a dense swamp forest, three women stood on the branches of a large tree, and a little fox lay relaxed on the head of the youngest woman. They looked around warily, and beneath them were various types of large beasts, but they didn't seem interested in the beasts below them.
'Hey Mei, explain to me about the stages of the beasts.' Zhang Fei asked, as he observed the beasts below them, he felt that the beasts were stronger than him.
[Basically, beasts are ranked the same as cultivators, Master. But the difference is the stages after Quasi-Divine, above Quasi-Divine, are Divine, Mythical, Immortal, and the last one is Primordial]
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows upon hearing that. 'Divine, Mythical, Immortal, and Primordial?'
[Yes! Based on the data provided by the creator, there were only two Primordial beasts in the entire universe.]
[Divine rank: Luan, Thunder Bird, Raiju, and many more.]
[Mythical Rank: Golden Dragon, Fire and Ice Phoenix, Qilin, and many more. Oh, Heavenly Fox is also a Mythical beast.]
[As for the Immortal and Primordial Rank, I don't have the data about these two ranks.]

'Hmm? Heavenly Fox is also a Mythical beast?' Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that because he had also read about various kinds of mythical creatures from various countries before, but he had never read about the Heavenly Fox, so he asked curiously. 'Do the beasts still exist?'
[Yes, Heavenly Fox is a Mythical beast, and those beasts still exist, Master. Even some are still residing on earth.]
Zhang Fei was shocked to hear that, he really didn't expect that there were still mythical creatures on earth. 'If there are still beasts residing on earth, then why are there no cultivators and Qi?'
[I don't know why there are no cultivators and Qi on earth, Master. Because the creator didn't leave any record about it.]
Zhang Fei shook his head and sighed, then he asked again. 'Have you found the location of the Python-Tailed Tiger?'
[There are three Python-Tailed Tigers in the center of this swamp forest.]
Liu Qingyu suddenly spoke. "We have to go to the center of this swamp forest, I detected a Python-Tailed Tiger over there."
After she said that, Liu Qingyu immediately flew towards the center of the swamp forest, Chu Qing and Chu Ying following behind her.
In about ten minutes, they arrived at the center of the swamp forest, and in the center was a fairly large cave, but the surrounding area was also filled with powerful beasts.
"The beasts around the cave are very strong, Mom." Chu Ying said, as her eyes continued to observe the beasts.
Liu Qingyu nodded in agreement, she didn't dare to act rashly herself, because there were two beasts slightly above her, and she wouldn't be able to face them at the same time.
Chu Qing then asked impatiently. "What should we do now, Mom? Shall we share the task of luring the beasts away first?"
"We can't do that, Qing'er." Liu Qingyu shook her head. "Most of the beasts are stronger than you and Ying'er, it would be dangerous for both of you if we split up."
Zhang Fei also seemed to be in deep thought, especially since Mei had already informed him of the beast's strength, so he wasn't surprised that Liu Qingyu didn't dare to make hasty decisions.

[Actually, it was very easy for you to get rid of those beasts, Master.] Zhang Fei was puzzled by her words, Mei then continued. [You are Heavenly Fox, Master. If you release your beast aura, then the beasts will run away, but it will reveal your beast identity to Liu Qingyu.]
Zhang Fei kept racking his brain, thinking of a solution so they could enter the cave, and then he asked. 'Can I use my demon eyes on those beasts?'

[Unfortunately, you can't use your demon eyes on those beasts, Master.] After that, Mei fell silent, and a few moments later she spoke again. [The only way is to use your demon pheromone, but those three women will also be affected.]

'Demon pheromone, huh?' Zhang Fei was inwardly muttering, and he was unsure whether to use it or not because he didn't want the three of them to be forced to become his women, especially Chu Qing and Chu Ying, who were still virgins.
"It seems—" Liu Qingyu wanted to say something, but suddenly she stopped talking and frowned, and she looked into the distance, then gave a low cry. "You two get out of here now!"
"But Mom-"
Liu Qingyu interrupted Chu Ying. "Quickly get your little sister out of here, Ying'er."
"Alright then." Chu Ying turned to fly away, as she grabbed her little sister's hand.
Chu Qing flew, as she kept looking back, and she asked anxiously. "Are we leaving Mom, Big Sis?"
"Looks like Mom detected something or someone dangerous, Qing'er." Chu Ying actually didn't want to leave her mother either, but if they stayed, then they would become a hindrance to their mother.
'What the hell happened, Mei? Why does Qingyu look panicked?' Zhang Fei asked nervously, as he didn't want anything to happen to Liu Qingyu.
[Master, there are two people whose strength is on par with her heading towards the center of the swamp, and it looks like they're coming for her because their auras lock onto her.]

Zhang Fei darkened upon hearing that, then he looked back; he wouldn't let Liu Qingyue die, as he wanted to have her as his woman. He didn't care anymore if they were suspicious of him, then he spoke to Chu Qing via telepathy. 'You two keep flying away, I will save your mother!'
Chu Qing was taken aback by Zhang Fei's voice in her mind, but before she could say anything to him, he had already used his teleportation to return to Liu Qingyu's place.
"What happened to you, Qing'er?" Chu Ying asked, as her eyes continued to focus forward, and she did not notice that Zhang Fei was no longer with them.
"Nothing, I'm just worried about mom." She then looked back, and she inwardly muttered. 'I hope you can save mom and come back safely, because you owe me an explanation, Qiao (Zhang Fei).'

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Saving Liu Qingyu
paragraphs: *BAM*
In front of Liu Qingyu, there was a man with long black hair; behind him stood a woman with long brown hair, but the woman's eyes had lost their radiance, and her gaze was blank.

The man said with a grin as he continued to stare at Liu Qingyu. "You won't be able to run from me anymore, Qingyu. I will capture you today, and I will make Chu Hong feel the agony that I have felt since years ago."

Liu Qingyu gritted her teeth upon hearing that, then she glanced at the woman standing behind him, and she sighed at the sight of the woman. 'It seems that she has truly become a puppet now, and she has lost her soul.' "It won't be easy for you to capture me, Pang Hong!"
Pang Hong snorted and took out his saber, the woman also took out two short daggers, then they mobilized their Qi, and they then directly attacked Liu Qingyu from two directions.
'Damn it!' Liu Qingyu's body was enveloped by white Qi, then she took out her white sword.
*Clang*
"Gah!" Although Liu Qingyu managed to deflect Pang Hong's saber, but the woman's dagger hit her back, leaving a deep slash wound.
Liu Qingyu spun around, then she thrust her sword at the woman, and her sword managed to stab the woman's shoulder.
Even though Liu Qingyu's sword was stabbed in her shoulder, the woman didn't seem to feel any pain, and instead swung her dagger at her. At the same time, Pang Hong also swung his saber at her.

Sensing that, Liu Qingyu pulled her sword out from the woman's shoulder, then she flew to the side to avoid their attacks, and she waved her hand towards them. The next second, two white swords from Qi shot out from her hand toward them.
"Cheap trick!" Pang Hong, who was shrouded in black Qi, swung his saber toward the white Qi swords.
The woman was the same, she used her two daggers to deflect the white sword Qi.
*BAMM*
A small explosion sounded as their weapons collided with the white sword Qi, the explosion agitated the beasts below, and the two powerful beasts that Liu Qingyu had observed earlier stared at them.
Suddenly, the woman's body was blown away, and a white sword Qi was stabbed into her stomach, but the woman still didn't show any reaction; she pulled out the white sword Qi and threw it away.
'Tsk, she really doesn't feel any pain anymore.' Liu Qingyu mumbled as she jumped onto a tree branch a bit far from Pang Hong.

The woman then spun in the air, and she immediately landed behind Pang Hong. He raised his eyebrows seeing that, he didn't understand how Liu Qingyu could do that. 'Looks like she has another trick up her sleeve.' "To think that your abilities have improved more than before, Qingyu."
"Humph!" Liu Qingyu snorted, and in the next second, ten white swords of Qi appeared around her. "I told you, it won't be easy for you to capture me, Pang Hong."
But Pang Hong actually laughed at her words, then he sneered. "Are you sure, Qingyu?"

Liu Qingyu raised her eyebrows, she suddenly realized something, but it was already too late, because three arrows of black Qi pierced her body from behind. One arrow pierced her left shoulder, another pierced her right hand, and another pierced her leg. The ten sword Qi around her also shattered instantly.

"Argh!" Liu Qingyu screamed in pain, her sword slipped from her hand, and she herself almost fell off a tree branch. Fortunately, her left hand managed to grab the tree branch, then she returned to the tree branch, and sat on it. She held the wound in her hand, as she looked at Pang Hong in shock. 'How did his arrows pierce my Light Shield?'

Pang Hong's lips curled up, then he stretched out his hand, and three black Qi arrows appeared in his hand. "Heh, I know that your Light Shield is indeed extraordinary, but my Dark Qi is already different from before, and your Light Shield won't be able to withstand it anymore."

'Damn it!' Liu Qingyu felt a little fear in her heart, she had always relied on her Light Shield, but now Pang Hong's Dark Qi had broken through her Light Shield. 'What should I do now? If he manages to capture me, then it will endanger my family.'
"You'd better surrender to me, Qingyu. Otherwise, I will definitely make you suffer." Pang Hong said with a vile grin, then he ordered the woman behind him. "Capture that woman, my puppet."

Having received orders from Pang Hong, the woman immediately moved toward Liu Qingyu. She gritted her teeth, her body was still in pain from being hit by his three arrows earlier, and she was unable to move freely.

But suddenly Liu Qingyu felt that someone was hugging her waist, and they instantly teleported to a tree branch further away. Pang Hong was shocked to see that, the woman also stopped on the branch of the tree where Liu Qingyu was earlier, Pang Hong stared at Liu Qingyu who was some distance away in disbelief.

Pang Hong was even more shocked when he saw the man who was hugging Liu Qingyu's waist, the man with long white hair with big fox ears, and a fox tail behind his hips, moreover the man looked so handsome and dashing.

Liu Qingyu then looked back, and she was dumbfounded when she saw his face, but somehow she felt so close to him, and she also felt a tremendous attraction towards him. 'What happened to me? Why am I so attracted to him? And this feeling is like the one I had for the little fox.'
[Her wound is quite severe, Master. Use your Light Qi to heal the wound.] Mei said.
The man was none other than Zhang Fei in his half-fox form, he channeled his Light Qi into Liu Qingyu's body according to Mei's instructions, as he asked her. "Are you all right, Qingyu?'

chapters.title: Chapter 23: I Can't Fight You, But They Can
paragraphs: The man was none other than Zhang Fei in his half-fox form, he channeled his Light Qi into Liu Qingyu's body according to Mei's instructions, as he asked her. "Are you all right, Qingyu?'
"Who are you? Why did you save me?" Liu Qingyu asked as she continued to stare in awe at Zhang Fei's handsome face; it made her even less aware that his cultivation was far below her.
Zhang Fei smiled at her, and he kissed Liu Qingyu's lips for a moment, then he looked at Pang Hong and the woman.
Liu Qingyu was dumbfounded by that, but she didn't scold him and instead smiled sweetly, and it was due to his demon charm effect on her. 'What happened to me? Why did I let him kiss my lips?'

But suddenly, Pang Hong's loud speech woke Liu Qingyu from her thoughts. "Heh, I thought you were a strong person, but it turns out that your cultivation is only at the 6 Star Elementary Realm, and you are seeking death by interfering in my affairs."

Liu Qingyu was shocked to hear that, then she sensed Zhang Fei's cultivation and directly told him. "I'm grateful that you wanted to save me, but you should get out of here right now since you're not his opponent."

"En, I know, but I can't leave you alone, Qingyu." Zhang Fei said with a sincere smile. It made Liu Qingyu's feelings more chaotic, and she became more and more affected by the effects of the demon charm. "Moreover, I have promised Chu Qing to take you home, and I will keep my promise to her."
"Eh?" Liu Qingyu stared at him with repeated blinks; she didn't recognize Zhang Fei. Moreover, she never knew that her daughter was friends with a half-fox like him.

"You can dream of taking her away from here, brat!" Pang Hong said disdainfully because Zhang Fei's cultivation was meaningless in his eyes, and he felt confident that he could kill him easily. Then he grinned, and three arrows of black Qi shot straight toward Zhang Fei and Liu Qingyu.
But Zhang Fei smiled faintly; he used his teleportation directly, and he took Liu Qingyu with him to the top of the cave.
*BAMM*

Pang Hong frowned at that; he didn't understand how a weak cultivator like Zhang Fei could dodge his attacks so fast, even though he knew that Zhang Fei was a half-fox. He didn't recognize the type of his fox bloodline, let alone his technique. "Tsk, an insect like you only knows to run away."
Zhang Fei chuckled. "Hey senile old man, running away is also a tactic in fighting, you know."

"Puchi~" Liu Qingyu laughed hearing Zhang Fei address Pang Hong as a senile old man, and she kept staring at Zhang Fei's face. 'He's really handsome and also has guts, not many people dare to talk to Pang Hong like that.'

Pang Hong darkened at his words, then he sneered at Zhang Fei again. "Heh, let's see how long you can use that escape technique. I'm sure that you will run out of Qi soon. Do you think you can fight and escape from me without Qi?"
However, Pang Hong ignored the fact that those beasts did not attack Zhang Fei and Liu Qingyu; not even Liu Qingyu noticed because she was too mesmerized by Zhang Fei.
"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed at his words, then his hand pointed at the beasts. "I can't fight you, but they can."
Pang Hong and Liu Qingyu were taken aback by his words, then they turned to the beasts. Sure enough, the beasts looked frightened of Zhang Fei, and their bodies also seemed to tremble violently.
'What the hell happened to them?' Pang Hong inwardly screamed in shock at the sight of the beasts, especially the two beasts whose strength was above him and Liu Qingyu.
Liu Qingyu muttered to herself in Zhang Fei's arms. "What happened to them? Why are they so frightened of him?"

Pang Hong and Liu Qingyu were confused by the beast's behavior, because they couldn't sense Zhang Fei's Heavenly Fox aura, but the beasts could, and his aura made the beasts feel pressured and frightened by him.
"Heh, we'll talk later, Qingyu." Zhang Fei then pointed at Pang Hong, and he shouted. "Listen up! All of you beat up that guy, or I'll slaughter you all!"

paragraphs: Hospital
Zhang Hai and the others were anxiously waiting in front of the emergency room, and a woman walked up to them, and she asked. "Was it you who called me earlier, Mr. Zhang?"
They turned towards the woman, Qing Yi raised an eyebrow at the woman, as she could recognize her identity instantly, but she didn't expect that her husband would call her.
"Yes, it was I who called you earlier, Hong Yao." Zhang Hai replied with a nod.
Hong Yao herself recognized their identity as Zhang Fei's parents, then she asked him again. "What can I do for you, Mr. Zhang?"
"I want you to arrest Zhang Fei for acts of violence, because he injured my son Zhang He, and he is currently receiving treatment inside." Zhang Hai answered bluntly.
Hearing that, Qing Yi immediately stood up from her seat, and glared at her husband, then shouted at him. "What do you mean by that, Zhang Hai? You want to throw my son in jail?"
"He is not our son anymore! We have disowned him long ago!" Zhang Hai retorted, especially after his wife called him by name directly.

"You're such an idiot, Zhang Hai! Even if we disowned him, Fei'er is still our son, and I was the one who gave birth to him. Moreover, He'er was the one who was looking for trouble with him, so you shouldn't throw him in jail!" After that, Qing Yi turned to leave and said one last time.
"If you insist on sending Fei'er to prison, then I will not return with you to Guangzhou again, if necessary I will divorce you."
Zhang Hai froze upon hearing that, he couldn't believe that his wife preferred their second son over him, and he felt lost because of it.

Chen Xin opened her mouth to say something, but she quickly closed her mouth again. Even though she felt immense pleasure when having sex with Zhang Fei, in her eyes the Zhang family's wealth meant more to her.

'So Zhang Fei was disowned by his family for a long time? No wonder he works as a laborer in a food cannery.' Hong Yao was shocked to hear that, as she had never heard of it before, then she said. "I'm sorry, I can't help you with this matter, Mr. Zhang. If you still insist on doing it, then you can make a formal report to the police station directly.
But I can tell you one thing, if you insist on imprisoning Zhang Fei, then you have made a grave mistake because you do not understand him at all."

After she said that, Hong Yao immediately turned away leaving Zhang Hai dumbfounded, and she inwardly muttered. 'You don't even know that your son is a demon, and no prison can hold him. Moreover, I am the demon's servant, so how can I arrest my master?'

Zhang Hai couldn't help but stare at Hong Yao who kept walking away dumbfounded, he felt confused about why everyone was defending Zhang Fei, especially since her tone sounded full of confidence when she spoke about him.
Chen Xin was also surprised and confused about Zhang Fei at the same time, especially after she had sex with him, she could feel that the current him was indeed not the same as the old him.
Outside the hospital, Qing Yi was looking for a taxi to go back to the village, but suddenly Hong Yao patted her on the shoulder, as she said. "Let me take you home, Mrs. Zhang."
Qing Yi turned to her and asked. "Do you want to arrest Fei'er, Hong Yao?"
"Unfortunately, I can't do that." Hong Yao replied with a shake of her head, then she took Qing Yi to her car, and drove her back to the village.

Halfway through, they continued to be silent for a long time. Suddenly, Qing Yi remembered Zhang Fei's identity as an incubus and asked suspiciously. "Why can't you arrest Fei'er? Do you have a special relationship with him?"
Hearing Qing Yi's question, Hong Yao was stunned for a moment and asked back. "What makes you think I have a special relationship with him?"

"My intuition as a woman says that you guys have a special relationship." Qing Yi replied casually, she still wasn't sure about their relationship, so she didn't want to talk to her about her son being an incubus.
Hong Yao thought for a moment before she asked. "Could it be that you already know about your son's true identity?"
"Hmm? What do you mean by that?" Qing Yi asked back with feigned ignorance. 'So my hunch was correct, Hong Yao does have a special relationship with Fei'er.'
Hong Yao then stopped the car and looked at Qing Yi doubtfully, she finally asked. "Have you had sex with the demon?"
Qing Yi froze upon hearing that, and her face flushed red, she didn't expect Hong Yao would ask her such a thing.

Hong Yao chuckled seeing her expression. "Have you forgotten that I am the chief of police? From the start, I have observed your attitude when talking about Zhang Fei, and your reaction makes me sure that you already know his identity as a demon, and that you have also had sex with him. Isn't that right?"
Qing Yi sighed heavily and nodded. "Sigh, you are right, I did know his identity as an incubus, and I also had sex with him."

"But you are still better than me because you are his mother. As for me, I am only his servant." Hong Yao replied with a bitter smile, even though she enjoyed having sex with Zhang Fei, she didn't like her status as his servant.

Qing Yi didn't say anything, even though she was his mother, but she felt that Zhang Fei only treated her as a sex object. Even so, she did not blame him, because it was the result of her past decisions.
After that, they continued their journey again.
Zhang Chen's Room
"Hmm? Why are you here, Fei'er?" Zhang Chen gently asked.
Zhang Fei then sat beside her and took her hand, saying. "Grandma, I want to take you somewhere else tonight, that way you can be healthier in the future."
"Where do you want to take me to?" Since she already knew about her grandson's identity as an incubus, Zhang Chen would no longer be surprised if he said something out of the ordinary.
'Mei, open the gate to the Jade Sacred Realm.' She immediately followed Zhang Fei's order, and a white gate opened in front of them, leaving Zhang Chen dumbfounded.
Before Zhang Fei could explain to his grandmother, two women walked out of the gate, and one of them grumbled. "Ugh! The air here is really dirty! I even have to cover my nose with Qi!"
"Ying'er? Qing'er? Why did you two enter that gate?" Zhang Fei asked in surprise since his body double was practicing elsewhere, and the gate was connected to the Chu Clan's back garden.

Chu Qing then jumped onto Zhang Fei's lap and kissed him on the lips, making Zhang Chen even more dumbfounded. "Hehe, even though you just came back here, I already miss you, Fei. So when I saw the gate open, I immediately pulled big sis to enter it."

"Qing'er, you are not polite; look who is beside you." Chu Ying warned her little sister, then she said to Zhang Chen. "Please forgive my little sister's rudeness, Grandma. Anyway, my name is Chu Ying, and I am Fei's future wife."
Chu Qing blushed looking at Zhang Chen, and she then took her hand and said. "Hehe, please forgive me, Grandma. My name is Chu Qing, and I am Fei's lover."

Zhang Chen looked at the Chu Sisters in turn; she was still shocked to see them coming out of the gate. Moreover, they claimed to be her grandson's lover and future wife, but she felt they were beautiful and kind. Then she turned to Zhang Fei. "Who exactly are they, Fei'er? How did they get out of that gate? Where did they come from?"

chapters.title: Chapter 49: Women Talks
paragraphs: After leaving his grandmother's room, Zhang Fei immediately went to deliver all the meat Zhong Yan ordered. As for Zhang Chen, she decided to go to his room, she wanted to talk to the two women.

The two women who were still exhausted were shocked to see Zhang Chen enter Zhang Fei's room, especially since they were still completely naked. Qing Yi directly covered her naked body with a blanket. "Mom, this-"

"You don't need to explain anything to me, Yi'er." Zhang Chen interrupted her as she sat in front of them. "To be honest, I've seen the madness you guys have with Fei'er earlier, but I still can't believe that you would enter into an incestuous relationship with him."

Qing Yi and Hong Yao were stunned upon hearing her words, they fell silent trying to remember their previous activities, and they remembered that their moans were so loud that Zhang Chen could hear them. 'Sigh, it's my fault, I couldn't control myself while having sex with him.'

Zhang Chen sighed softly seeing their expressions. "I know that Fei'er must have done something to you guys, especially since he is now an incubus, and incubus are always depicted as lustful creatures."
"You already know about that, Mom?" Qing Yi was surprised to hear that, Hong Yao also didn't expect Zhang Fei would tell his grandmother about his identity.

"Yes! Fei'er has already told me everything about what happened to him three days ago." Zhang Chen then looked at them seriously before asking again. "What will you guys do now? Moreover, you both have husbands."

"I don't know what to do next, Aunt Chen." Hong Yao shook her head and sighed softly. "Ever since I had sex with Zhang Fei, I have never dared to meet my husband again. Sadly, he doesn't think of me as his woman, and he only sees me as his servant."
Zhang Chen frowned at that, but she chose not to say anything, and she left the decision in Hong Yao's hands.

Qing Yi herself was still confused about her next step. On the one hand, she really enjoyed having sex with her son. But on the other hand, she was still Zhang Hai's wife, and he was also his father. After thinking for some time, she finally answered her question. "I'm sorry, but I think I will divorce Zhang Hai, Mom."
"Hmm?" Zhang Chen was surprised to hear that. "Why did you decide like that, Yi'er?"

Qing Yi sighed heavily and sat on the side of the bed. "I've betrayed Zhang Hai with our son, so I don't feel worthy to be his wife anymore. Moreover, our relationship has never been good either, but I've always kept things to myself."

"Please explain to me." Since Zhang Chen had always lived separately from her son and daughter-in-law, she did not know what was really going on in their married life. Beside that, she was also still curious about her decision to support Zhang Hai to abandon and disowning Zhang Fei two years ago, mainly because she knew that Qing Yi loved her second son very much before that day.

Qing Yi nodded and started to explain everything to Zhang Chen, especially about Zhang Hai's attitude which had started to change after Zhang Yue's birth, and coupled with his steadily rising career, he had become extremely harsh towards her. Since then, he often abused her with dirty words, and he also frequently beat her.

Even so, she still tries hard to save their marriage for the sake of their children. For years she kept hoping that her husband would change, but sadly her hopes were in vain. Even though she had given birth to Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin, her husband had never changed, and his attitude had only gotten worse.

Hong Yao was shocked to hear that, she didn't expect Zhang Hai had the heart to treat the woman who had given birth to four children for him like that, she then sighed in and hugged Qing Yi to comfort her.
Zhang Chen's face darkened and saddened upon hearing that. "So that's why you chose to support Hai'er to do that to Fei'er?"

"Yes." Qing Yi nodded while shedding tears. "That day, I had begged him not to do that to Fei'er, but instead he beat me multiple times. Since I didn't dare to go against him, so I decided to support his decision."

Zhang Chen sighed heavily, she was also aware that her son had changed drastically since his career had steadily risen, and he was becoming more and more blinded by wealth, status, and authority. "Sigh, if you want to divorce Hai'er, then I will support your decision.
Even though he is my son, I really don't like his current personality and attitude, he cares more about worldly things than his own family."

"Is that true, Mom? You will support me in divorcing him?" Qing Yi asked in surprise, she thought that Zhang Chen would be angry with her. But instead, she supported her decision to divorce Zhang Hai.

Zhang Fei's identity as an incubus made Zhang Chen realize a few things, and she was certain that her daughter-in-law would never be able to escape from him again. Even though she felt the relationship between them was a big mistake, she chose to support them, especially after she learned about cultivators and other worlds. "Sigh!
Moreover, after what you two have done, you can't leave Fei'er anymore, right?"

Qing Yi's face turned bright red hearing that, and she nodded to him. "That's right, Mom. Ever since I had sex with Fei'er once, I don't want to be separated from him again. Even though he's still mad at me now, and he also doesn't think of me as his mother anymore, but I will try hard to get his forgiveness."

Zhang Chen nodded in agreement, she knew exactly her grandson's character. Although he looks kind and gentle, he is also vengeful, that's why he still can't forgive Qing Yi. "As long as you stay with us, I'm sure Fei'er will forgive you sooner or later, especially if he knew the reason behind your decision two years ago."
However, Qing Yi shook her head. "No, I'd rather try hard than tell him about my relationship with his father, Mom."

"Well, if that's your decision, I won't interfere anymore, but you should work hard to earn his forgiveness." Zhang Chen said as she got up from her seat. "As for you, I don't know what to do for you, Hong Yao."
After Zhang Chen left, Qing Yi heaved a sigh of relief. She was relieved that her mother-in-law didn't blame her, and she also supported her in being with her son.
As for Hong Yao, she had actually made up her mind, but she didn't want to discuss it with anyone else.

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Zhong Yan's Restlessness
paragraphs: In a restaurant, two women are sitting facing each other while enjoying the food in front of them. They were none other than Ru Xue and Zhong Yan, but Zhong Yan looked so agitated.

"Why did you suddenly invite me to meet, Yan? Didn't we just meet this morning? And why are you so agitated?" Ru Xue asked with a smile, but she already knew that Zhong Yan had become like that due to the effects of Zhang Fei's actions.

Zhong Yan stirred her drink and sighed heavily, then she answered her question. "To be honest, I don't know what happened to me, Xue. Ever since the two of you left my house, I haven't been able to concentrate on my work, and I've always had Fei'er in my mind."

Ru Xue inwardly laughed at her answer, she didn't expect that Zhong Yan would fall so quickly by Zhang Fei's demon charm. She then took her hand and rubbed it, asking her. "Does that mean you are interested in Fei'er?"

"I don't know." Zhong Yan shook her head, then she fell silent for a moment before continuing. "I know Fei'er is a good man and a hard worker, but he's too young, so I don't know if I'm attracted to him or not."

'Sigh, she always thinks too much, that's why she never looked for a replacement for her deceased husband.' Ru Xue muttered in her heart, she then looked at Zhong Yan and thought about whether she should tell him about Zhang Fei or not, before she said. "I know that Fei'er is still very young, but he is very different from other men."
"Hmm? What do you mean by that?" Zhong Yan asked in confusion, she felt that Zhang Fei was no different from other men, but he was indeed very good in her eyes.

"I feel at a loss explaining it to you, but if you want to know the real Fei'er, it would be best if you go see him and ask him in person." Zhong Yan raised her eyebrows hearing that, she was confused by her words, Ru Xue then held his hands tightly and seriously spoke. "Trust me, you won't regret it if you accept Fei'er as your man.
However, the problem is that he may have many women in the future, and I am one of them."

"Hmm? Does that mean that Fei'er is a playboy now? Why are you willing to accept him? Are you willing to share him with other women?" Zhong Yan asked in an irritated tone, and she felt disappointed in him because of that.

Ru Xue smiled wryly at her question, especially at Zhong Yan's irritated tone. She herself was still thinking about Zhang Fei's situation, but she couldn't do anything against her fate, especially since she already had his demon partner mark, and she had to have sex with him at least once a week. In addition, after she had sex with him several times, she felt more and more unable to escape from him.
"Yes, I am willing to share him with other women. Anyway, I really can't explain his situation to you, but I dare to guarantee that he is not what you think."

Zhong Yan looked at her best friend with a dark face, she couldn't believe that she was willing to share a man with other women. After that, she thought deeply for a long time, and Ru Xue didn't bother her thinking.
Minutes later, Zhong Yan took a deep breath and spoke. "I want you to accompany me to meet Fei'er, I don't dare to meet him alone, I'm afraid that I will lose control after meeting him."
"Alright, I'll accompany you." After that, Zhong Yan and Ru Xue finished their meal, and they went to Zhang Chen's house afterward.

Thirty minutes later, they arrived in front of Zhang Chen's house, and Zhang Fei himself was about to walk into the house. Fortunately, he arrived ahead of them by a few moments, so Zhong Yan did not see him move so quickly.
"Anyway, I just came back from delivering the venison, Big Sis Yan." Zhang Fei immediately said as soon as they got off the car.

Zhong Yan didn't reply and kept looking at Zhang Fei lovingly, her face flushed red, and her heart pounded wildly. She even had to try hard to keep herself from jumping into his arms. 'Sigh, what exactly happened to me? Why do I want to hug and kiss him so much?'

Mei suddenly burst out laughing. [Haha, I didn't expect that she would fall into your demon charm so quickly, Master. It seems that she has been very lonely in the past 5 years, so she fell this fast.]
'En, that seems to be the case, Mei.' Zhang Fei replied with a slight nod.
"I asked Ru Xue to accompany me to meet you, and I wanted to talk to you about something private." Zhong Yan replied calmly, but her heart was racing.
Zhang Fei then asked with an innocent smile. "What made you suddenly want to meet me, Big Sis Yan? Didn't we just meet this morning?"

Ru Xue inwardly laughed seeing Zhang Fei pretending to be innocent, but she was also still shocked by the technique's effects. It hasn't even been a day, but Zhong Yan has already fallen deeply. 'Fei'er is already such an actor, he can even pretend to be innocent so perfectly.'

Seeing his innocent smile, Zhong Yan averted her gaze to the side, and she replied as her heart pounded violently. "Can we talk somewhere else, Fei'er? I'm not comfortable talking about it at your house."
"En, alright then." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, then he walked into the house to tell his grandma that he was going out with Zhong Yan and Ru Xue.
Ru Xue pulled Zhong Yan closer, and she whispered. "Have you made up your mind, Yan? If you accept him, then you will have no way back."
Zhong Yan shook her head at Ru Xue, then she turned around, and looked up at the sky. "Perhaps it is time for me to end my loneliness, but I will only decide after I speak to Fei'er first."
Since Zhang Fei had expected what she would ask, after he left the house, he asked Zhong Yan to take them to a place where there were no passersby.
